source_refs.note: Unnumbered heading Evaluating and Improving Solutions, as printed (PDF 26, printed 22).

blocks.text: After finding a solution, it is important to evaluate it. Evaluation helps us check if the solution is correct. It allows us to find and fix mistakes. Testing the solution shows whether it works properly. We can improve the solution by making it simpler or faster. This process helps us learn from errors. Improving solutions leads to better performance. Evaluation is an important part of problem-solving.
